UserAppState.title: UserAppState
UserAppState.description: Private per-user meal planner state including pantry quantities, Walmart list, meal variety preferences, favorites, custom meals, and optional household link.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the state owner.

pantryItems.description: User pantry items with item name and numeric quantity.

groceryItems.description: User Walmart grocery list items organized by aisle.

rutMeals.description: Meals the user optionally marked to see less often or twist.

customMeals.description: AI-generated or rescued custom meals saved by the user.

householdId.description: Optional household invite code if sharing pantry and grocery list.

kitchenProfile.description: Optional persisted cooking equipment, living situation / dorm constraints, effort level, dietary filters, and variety preferences.

Household.title: Household
Household.description: Optional shared household container identified by a short invite code.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who created the household.

name.description: Friendly display label for the household.

HouseholdMember.title: HouseholdMember
HouseholdMember.description: Membership record granting access to a shared household.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the member.

displayName.description: Non-PII short display name shown to household members.

joinedAt.description: Server timestamp when user joined the household.

HouseholdSharedState.title: HouseholdSharedState
HouseholdSharedState.description: Shared pantry and Walmart grocery list synced between household members.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the household creator.

updatedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the member who last updated the shared state.

pantryItems.description: Shared household pantry items with quantities.

groceryItems.description: Shared household Walmart grocery list items.

/users/{userId}/appState/{stateId}.description: Private meal planner state for an individual signed-in user.

/households/{householdId}.description: Optional shared household metadata keyed by invite code.

/households/{householdId}/sharedState/{s.description: Shared pantry and Walmart grocery list for members of a household.
